title: A collapsed group stays collapsed when a search finds work inside it
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 for customer "Fibridge Commercial" and S1-644 for "Fisquare Farms", both led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Collapse Esther Howard's group (arrow on her header).
  5. Click Search and type Fibridge.
  6. Read Esther Howard's group header and whether any of her rows show.
  7. Expand Esther Howard's group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • During the search Esther Howard's group stays collapsed: it does not open by itself.
  • Its header count shows how many of her work orders match: 1 (S1-702 only).
  • Expanding it shows the 1 matching row, S1-702.
  • The design opens every group that has a match while searching: if the build does that, it is a fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R16, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD footer comment Slavcho Mitrov 2 Oct 2026 item 1, folded into the 7 Oct PRD. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), By Lead Tech search behaviour; on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R16: “When a search or filter finds work orders inside a group the user collapsed, the group stays collapsed; its count shows how many match. Collapsing is the user's saved choice (S2-R13).”
